model.files.locationModels

Class MyLocationsHolder

  • java.lang.Object
    • model.files.common.BaseFile<T>
      • model.files.common.JsonFile<LocationModel>
        • model.files.locationModels.MyLocationsHolder
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    IFileMethods<LocationModel>

    public final class MyLocationsHolder
extends JsonFile<LocationModel>
    This is my locations holder singleton implementation for holding the single ref point to locations.json, and it's also used to parse and return the locations from the file.

    2
    Author:
    RazvanNuta

      • ParseFile

        public HashMap<Integer,LocationModel> ParseFile()
                                         throws DataFileException
        Description copied from class: JsonFile
        This method is used to parse a generic json file that supports type of T as model, and will parse to the type of T in the override method of parseJSON in each class that derives from this class. If the input file is missing or empty, a message is printed and the returned map is empty.
        Overrides:
        ParseFile in class JsonFile<LocationModel>
        Returns:
        HashMap<Integer, T>, where T is the model of the object to be read from the input file. Because T extends ICommonFileModel, it has access to the getId method from T.
        Throws:
        DataFileException - In the case the input file cannot be read or it does not contain a valid JSON throws this exception.
        See Also:
        MyFilesHolder, MyLocationsHolder

      • getRootLocations

        public List<LocationModel> getRootLocations(Collection<LocationModel> allLocations)
        This method is used to find the root locations, the ones that are not a sub location of any other location. The locations are shown in the menu and saved in locations.json starting from these roots, with their sub locations inside them.
        Parameters:
        allLocations - All the locations, including the sub locations
        Returns:
        The locations that are not a sub location of another location

      • validatePath

        public String validatePath(String path)
                    throws InvalidLocationException,
                           DuplicateLocationException
        This method is used to validate the path of a new location, before the name of the location is read from the console. The path is normalized first ("/" becomes "\" and the "\" from the end is removed). Then it must have a valid format, starting with a drive (for example C:\), it must not be monitored already and, if it is not a drive, one of its parent folders must be monitored.
        Parameters:
        path - The path of the new location, as it was read from the console
        Returns:
        The normalized path, that will be the path of the new location
        Throws:
        InvalidLocationException - In the case the path is empty, has an invalid format or none of its parent folders is monitored throws this exception.
        DuplicateLocationException - In the case a location with the same path is already monitored throws this exception.
        See Also:
        addLocation(String, String)

      • addLocation

        public LocationModel addLocation(String path,
                                 String name)
                          throws InvalidLocationException
        This method is used to add a new location created by the user, in memory, under its closest monitored parent folder (a drive is added as a root location). The locations that are already monitored inside the new path become sub locations of the new location, similar to a real desktop. The new location receives the biggest id + 1 and the USER_CREATED type.
        Parameters:
        path - The path of the new location, already validated and normalized by validatePath
        name - The name of the new location
        Returns:
        The added location, with the sub locations that were moved under it
        Throws:
        InvalidLocationException - In the case the name is empty throws this exception.
        See Also:
        validatePath(String), LocationType

      • deleteLocation

        public List<Integer> deleteLocation(LocationModel location)

        Parameters:
        location - The location to be deleted, chosen by name or id from the menu
        Returns:
        The ids of the deleted location and of all its sub locations
